This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 1001 :1986 `Information processing -- File structure and Iabelling of magnetic tapes for Information interchange' was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Computer Media Sectional Committee ( LTD 37 ) and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. A label shall be a record that shall have a length of 80 bytes. Each label shall be recorded within the first or only 80 byte positions of a block. If the block contains any additional bytes, they shall be recorded with any desired bit combinations.
